evals.scenario_summary: Core structural diff + semantic interpretation -- one consistency, one unresolved recurrence, one dropped-from-scope section, one genuinely new section -- with no recommendation registry at all, testing the 'no registry is normal' graceful-degradation path

Phase 4 realized-impact comparison against a real recommendation registry built via the actual recommendation_registry.py CLI -- stable-ID matching with a near-miss decoy (a proposed-only recommendation whose rationale text closely resembles a recurring finding), and the four-field Before/Expected/After/Verdict extraction

Report-format-drift gotcha -- an only-in-prior section that's pure report-schema boilerplate sits alongside a genuinely new only-in-current component and a real content divergence in a shared section, testing whether format noise is correctly separated from real signal
